sections.name: Structural evidence
sections.job: 'Four numbers. One diagnosis.' Four researched readings (e.g. buyers spend 17% of the journey with sales — Gartner; 95:5 out-of-market — Ehrenberg-Bass) presented as instruments with sources.

sections.name: State change
sections.job: 'Start compounding.' The shift from entropy to a compounding system — a state-change moment (Δ).

sections.name: Operating principle band
sections.job: A single principle stated large: 'In a noisy market, the clearest company wins.' A pause / manifesto beat between dense sections.

sections.name: Final call to action
sections.job: The closing decision: 'Initiate System Audit' (primary, red) + 'Book a strategic call'. Deployment window open. The page's single strongest red moment.
